scope: Current local source; not a live-site verification. Indexable HTML main content, canonical article text, key informational pages and three public book readers. Unlisted and editorial-private content excluded from public findings.

method.normalization: Unicode NFC and whitespace; exact paragraphs >=90 characters; first prose body >=150 characters; same-title near matches using text similarity. Shared navigation/context removed before paragraph matching. Manual follow-up for actionable candidates.
limitations: Semantic repetition cannot be exhaustively detected by exact matching.
Books use differing layouts; public readers also manually inspected.
Identity consolidation requires existing canonical-author workflow. No literature or source files changed.

findings.title: Gitanjali Swain has two profile pages with identical biography and split works
findings.evidence: Same biography and source links; spelling differs only in the sw/w orthographic form. First profile lists2works; second lists1. Existing identity notes corroborate matching locality signatures and retired-teacher attribution; linked source signatures inspected.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate through the canonical-author merge workflow, preserving3contributions and original bylines. Existing research intentionally retained routes, so record the new merge decision explicitly.

findings.title: Jayanta Kumar Ojha has two profiles with identical biography and split works
findings.evidence: Names differ by spacing. First profile lists4works; second lists1. Existing identity record and inspected source signatures corroborate the same SSPL/DRDO/Timarpur institutional affiliation.

findings.title: News overview repeats seven archived news articles in full
findings.evidence: Seven exact paragraph matches between the news overview and original archive article pages. This duplicates reading length rather than creating new information.
findings.recommendation: Keep archive article originals; turn news overview into dated short summaries/excerpts with direct article links if editors want a shorter overview.

findings.title: ବାପା ମାଆ appears in May and July2026
findings.evidence: Same poem title, student author ଦିବ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱରୂପ ସାହୁ and exact normalized poem paragraph including school/class attribution; issue labels differ. Full article-text similarity0.977 because publication context differs.
findings.recommendation: Ask editors whether this was an intentional republication before deduplicating or changing issue membership. Preserve both archived originals until decision.

findings.title: Academy member list repeats two names
findings.evidence: ପ୍ରଶାନ୍ତ କୁମାର ସ୍ୱାଇଁ appears as96and107; ଲାବଣ୍ୟ ଚନ୍ଦ୍ର ସାହୁ appears as104and116.
findings.recommendation: Verify against academy roster before removing entries; identical names alone cannot prove identical people.

findings.title: Musha Mushi reader repeats its opening illustration before poem1
findings.evidence: Header img.cover-art and first img.story-art both use /books/musha_mushi/art/poem-01-v1.jpg.
findings.recommendation: For reader redesign, keep one compact book identity/header and begin at the first poem without a second large hero illustration. Keep artwork and source assets intact.

findings.title: Forest reader repeats its cover artwork as chapter1 opening
findings.evidence: Header img.cover and first img.story-art both use assets/forest-opening-v1-anatomy-v2.jpg.
findings.recommendation: Explore a compact reader header or cover as a separate first page to avoid two consecutive full presentations of the same illustration.

intentional_repetition: November all-writing.html is the complete-issue alternative to individual article pages; repeated article text is intentional, not two submissions in an edition.
Homepage, edition contents and author contribution pages reference the same articles intentionally. Shared navigation, edition context, source credits and author bylines are necessary orientation.
Book original scans, illustrated versions and text/reading variants preserve distinct reading purposes and should not be deleted because titles repeat.
Kete Jami illustrated reader reuses sprite-sheet image URLs with different panel crops; repeated src values are not repeated visual panels.

Brand page design/art sections and AI disclosure partly discuss similar topics but serve distinct design-principle and provenance/credit purposes. No exact long paragraph repetition found there after the recent consolidation.
